definitions.explanation: A large piece of cloth or fabric stretched horizontally, typically bearing a message, slogan, or design. Used at sporting events, demonstrations, ceremonies, and other gatherings.

examples.japanese: {横断幕|おうだんまく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{掲|かか}げる→掲げる：12791_kakageru⟧。
⟦スタジアム→スタジアム：23905_sutajiamu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{応援|おうえん}→応援：01900_ouen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{横断幕|おうだんまく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{並|なら}んでいた→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧。
examples.english: Cheering banners were lined up at the stadium.

examples.japanese: ⟦デモ→デモ：19416_demo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{参加者|さんかしゃ}→参加者：03059_sankasha⟧たち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧「⟦{戦争|せんそう}→戦争：01450_sensou⟧⟦{反対|はんたい}→反対：01497_hantai⟧」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{書|か}かれた→書く：00477_kaku⟧{横断幕|おうだんまく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}って→持つ：00478_motsu⟧⟦{行進|こうしん}→行進：22196_koushin⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The demonstrators marched carrying banners that read "No War."

notes:
Composed of ⟦{横断|おうだん}→横断：01906_oudan⟧ (crossing horizontally) and ⟦{幕|まく}→幕：12518_maku⟧ (curtain/screen). The name describes the horizontal orientation of the banner, distinguishing it from vertical banners ({垂|た}れ{幕|まく}).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {横断幕|おうだんまく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{掲|かか}げる→掲げる：12791_kakageru⟧: to hold up / display a banner
- {横断幕|おうだんまく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{張|は}る→張る：12583_haru⟧: to stretch out a banner
- ⟦{応援|おうえん}→応援：01900_ouen⟧{横断幕|おうだんまく}: cheering banner
- ⟦{抗議|こうぎ}→抗議：12807_kougi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{横断幕|おうだんまく}: protest banner
- {横断幕|おうだんまく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧: to write on a banner

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {垂|た}れ{幕|まく}: vertical banner / hanging banner — hangs vertically rather than stretching horizontally
- ⟦{旗|はた}→旗：02161_hata⟧: flag — a piece of cloth attached to a pole, not stretched between two points
- ⟦{幕|まく}→幕：12518_maku⟧: curtain / screen — broader term for any large piece of fabric used as a screen
- のぼり: vertical flag / streamer — a tall, narrow flag on a pole, common at shops and events
